fail_rule: if the 20-symbol universe stops finishing inside the 5-minute cadence or provider/rate/data failures appear, add no symbols and revert to the last proven universe by restoring the backed-up watchlist line
cohort_change_rule: any later change to setup, DTE, stop, target, filter, guard, floor, block, risk rules, or the universe starts a new cohort with a new epoch

previous_epochs.epoch_rule: deployed SHA + successful market-hours smoke timestamp; never the restart time

rules_in_force.late_entry_guard: PR #570 - refuse ACTIVE entry when live price is past target_1, past invalidation, or leaves < OPTIONS_PAPER_V1_MIN_REMAINING_RR (default 1.0) reward per unit of risk
rules_in_force.daily_lane_entry_timing: PR #571 - session-hourly 2U/2D confirmation not required (OPTIONS_PAPER_V1_DAILY_REQUIRE_HOURLY=false); SPY/QQQ trend alignment still required
rules_in_force.daily_lane_target_floor: PR #571 - prior-day levels closer than OPTIONS_PAPER_V1_DAILY_MIN_TARGET_RR (default 1.0) R from the trigger are skipped; no level beyond the floor -> counterfactual only, no synthetic target
rules_in_force.entry_late_episode_block: PR #575 - an episode refused ENTRY_LATE at its first actionable opportunity can never become ACTIVE; the refusal is preserved as a COUNTERFACTUAL observer row (no ACTIVE risk, no alert); a new trigger level or a new episode bucket is a new episode
rules_in_force.canonical_bar: 30Min completed bars with the SIP delay buffer (960 s); scans every 5 minutes; live quote evaluated for remaining reward/risk
rules_in_force.risk: max $300 planned risk per trade, $1,000 aggregate ACTIVE; 45+ DTE (14-44 exception); companion OFF
